name: noise_std
label: Membrane noise
tip: Random current added to every neuron each 5 ms step. Higher makes the brain flicker more on its own.

name: bias
label: Tonic drive
tip: Constant input to every neuron; at 0.20 a neuron rests at 80% of its firing threshold.

name: target_rate_hz
label: Target rate (Hz)
tip: The whole-brain firing rate the slow gain controller steers toward.

name: ext_gain
label: Sensory input gain
tip: How strongly hits, smells and other stimuli drive the sensory neurons they reach.

name: gain_adapt
label: Gain adaptation rate
tip: How fast the gain controller reacts. 0 freezes synaptic gain where it is.

name: thresh.escape
label: Dodge: DNp01 above
tip: The giant fiber's firing, as a multiple of its calm rate, that makes the fly dodge.

name: thresh.groom
label: Groom: aDN1/aDN2 above
tip: Antennal grooming command neurons' firing that logs a GROOM reaction (no body movement).

name: thresh.jump
label: Fly away: head-touch DNs above
tip: Head-touch DN threshold.

name: thresh.run
label: Run: body-touch DNs above
tip: Body-touch DN threshold.

name: thresh.kick
label: Kick: leg-touch DNs above
tip: Leg-touch DN threshold.

name: thresh.walk
label: Walk: DNp09 above
tip: Forward walking threshold.

name: thresh.back
label: Back up: MDN above
tip: Moonwalker threshold.

name: thresh.turn
label: Turn: DNa01/02 R-L above
tip: Steering difference threshold.

name: thresh.fly
label: Take off: DNg02 above
tip: Wing-power threshold.

name: thresh.fire
label: Shoot: DNp35 above
tip: Duel trigger threshold.

name: thresh.song
label: Song: ps1 wing MNs (1 s) above
tip: The two ps1 wing motor neurons' firing, averaged over about a second, that plays the courtship buzz (SONG).

name: thresh.aggression
label: Lunge: AVLP727m/pC1 above
tip: Aggression neurons' firing that throws the fly at the nearest other fly (LUNGE; needs 2+ flies).

name: thresh.sleep
label: Sleep: dFB FB6/FB7 above
tip: Dorsal fan-shaped body firing that puts the fly to rest (SLEEP): no spontaneous take-off or walking.

name: thresh.co2
label: CO2 log: V glomerulus PNs above
tip: V glomerulus projection neurons' firing that logs a CO2 reaction (no body movement).

name: thresh.hot_pn
label: Heat log: VP2 PNs above
tip: Hot-pathway projection neurons' firing that logs a HEAT reaction (no body movement).

name: thresh.cold_pn
label: Cold log: VP3 PNs above
tip: Cold-pathway projection neurons' firing that logs a COLD reaction (no body movement).

name: loom_min
label: Looming: ignored below (rad/s)
tip: Angular expansion speed below which approaching objects don't drive LPLC2/LC4 at all.

name: loom_full
label: Looming: full drive span (rad/s)
tip: How much faster than the minimum an object must grow to drive the looming detectors fully.

name: field.wind_dir
label: Open field: wind from (deg)
tip: Where the open field's steady wind comes from, in degrees (0 = +x). It drives the real JO-C/E wind neurons; how the two antennae split it by heading is a game rule.

name: field.wind_speed
label: Open field: wind speed (m/s)
tip: Steady wind strength in the open field. 6 m/s and above drives the wind neurons fully (game rule).

name: weather.rain
label: Weather: rain intensity
tip: Rain in the open field and the orchard (0 = none). Drops hit the body by part and fire the real touch neurons (head, body, legs, wings), the air drives the humidity neurons, and enough rain wets the wings so the fly can't take off, as after the pool. The hit rate, strengths, parts and wetting are game rules.

name: weather.gust_hz
label: Weather: gusts per second
tip: How often a gust blows in the open field and the orchard. A gust is extra wind speed (2-6 m/s for 1-3 s) fed through the existing wind -> Johnston's organ JO-C/E transduction. The gust's size, length and turn are game rules.

name: weather.storm
label: Weather: storm (0 off, 1 on)
tip: A storm is at least 70% rain, 0.2 gusts a second and +3 m/s of wind, a darker scene, and lightning every 5-14 s that drives the photoreceptors (the screen swells slowly instead of flashing with Reduced flashing on). Thunder follows the flash. The storm preset is a game rule.

name: outdoor.sun_az
label: Outdoors: sun azimuth (deg)
tip: Where the sun stands. Sunlight drives the real photoreceptors, split between the eyes by heading (game rule).

name: outdoor.sun_el
label: Outdoors: sun elevation (deg)
tip: How high the sun is: brightness of the light drive, and the scene's lighting. Below 0 it is night.

name: outdoor.day_s
label: Outdoors: day length (s, 0 = off)
tip: Day/night cycle: the sun circles once in this many seconds (noon +60 deg, midnight -30 deg), replacing the fixed sun above. Daylight drives the photoreceptors and the morning clock neurons l-LNv/s-LNv (game rule).

name: orchard.feeds
label: Orchard: feeds per fruit
tip: How many feeding bouts one fruit supports before it drops. Applies to fruit that grow from now on.

name: orchard.regrow_s
label: Orchard: regrow time (s)
tip: Mean time for a dropped fruit to grow back, jittered +-25% so regrowth is staggered.

name: orchard.cap
label: Orchard: fruit per tree (cap)
tip: Most fruit one tree carries at a time.

name: indiv.sigma_subtle
label: Individuality: subtle sigma
tip: Spread (log-normal sigma) of the per-neuron gains D_pre and D_post in W_fly = D_post·W·D_pre at Individuality Subtle. Signs never change. Applies to brains built from now on; validation always runs with individuality off.

name: indiv.sigma_strong
label: Individuality: strong sigma
tip: The same at Individuality Strong.

name: pet.hunger_h
label: Pet: hours from full to starving
tip: How fast the pet's hunger rises, on the wall clock and in the catch-up when you come back.

name: pet.awake_h
label: Pet: hours awake until exhausted
tip: How fast sleep pressure builds while the pet is awake.

name: pet.sleep_h
label: Pet: hours of sleep to recover
tip: How fast sleep pressure falls while the pet sleeps.

name: pet.sugar_gain
label: Pet: hunger boost to sugar taste
tip: Sugar drives the real taste neurons at (1 + this x hunger) times the normal strength.

name: pet.pam_gain
label: Pet: hunger boost to PAM reward
tip: Eating drives the real PAM reward dopamine neurons at (1 + this x hunger) times the normal strength.

name: pet.dfb_drive
label: Pet: sleep pressure to dFB drive
tip: Sleep pressure drives the real dorsal fan-shaped body sleep neurons (FB6/FB7) with this x pressure.

name: pet.max_catchup_d
label: Pet: longest catch-up (days)
tip: Time away longer than this counts as this long, so a clock jump cannot starve the pet. Read at launch.
